name: Vorgrim Ashscale
title: the Molten Warlord
facial: custom:dragon snout with fangs and glowing ember eyes

outfit.head: custom:red dragon head with swept-back horns
acc: custom:long ragged black cape with burning ember edges
custom:scaled dragon tail with ember glow

kit: custom:lava-veined greatsword with a cracked molten blade
silhouette: a towering horned dragon in black plate with a burning cape and a huge glowing blade
signature: a greatsword split by molten veins that brightens with every kill
fx: embers drift off the cape and blade; the veins in his armour pulse when he attacks
story: The last of the drake-lords of Ashgrave, Vorgrim slept under the pass for a hundred years. The Hollow woke him by digging up his kin, and he has been burning them out of the mountain ever since.
notes_for_3d: Big male knight with a custom dragon head (snout, fangs, swept horns), dragon-head pauldrons, torn tabard, a ragged ember-edged cape and a lizard tail with a glowing tip. Lava greatsword.

name: Talvo Brassfang
title: the Ember Duelist
facial: custom:slender dragon snout with a brass monocle

outfit.body: custom:long dark greatcoat with brass trim and buckled straps
outfit.head: custom:orange dragon head with small swept horns and a brass monocle
acc: custom:knee-length dark coat-tails tabard with brass trim
custom:scaled dragon tail with ember glow

kit: custom:flaming cutlass with a brass knuckle guard
silhouette: a lean dragon in a long coat with a curling ember tail and a burning sabre
signature: a monocled drake who duels with a cutlass that never stops burning
pose: cutlass flicked out, free hand on his coat
fx: fire trails from the cutlass; his tail sheds sparks when he dashes
story: Talvo keeps the Saltreach docks honest the old way: a challenge, a bow, and a blade that leaves the loser's coat smouldering. When the Hollow came up the harbour steps he simply bowed again.
notes_for_3d: Slim male with a custom dragon head (narrow snout, small horns) and a brass monocle over the right eye; a long greatcoat with brass trim; lizard tail with glowing cracks. Cutlass with a knuckle guard and a glowing blade.

name: Wystan Quillmere
title: the Owl Archivist

hair.style: custom:speckled brown feathers with tufted ear plumes

facial: custom:round owl face disc with a small hooked beak and round brass spectacles

outfit.body: custom:long moss-green hooded robe trimmed with leaves over a cream inner robe
outfit.head: custom:owl head with ear tufts and round brass spectacles
acc: custom:long moss-green robe with leaf-trimmed hem and flowing sleeves and a sash
custom:broad owl-feather capelet that flares like folded wings
custom:wide leather belt hung with scrolls and pouches

kit: custom:driftwood staff hung with crystal wind chimes and feathers
silhouette: a round owl in long green robes with a tall crooked staff of chimes
signature: a staff of crystal wind chimes that rings the wind into a healing breeze
fx: a pale green wind ribbon and drifting leaves when he casts
story: Wystan has catalogued every scroll in the Thornwick archive twice. The second time he noticed the pages that were missing, all of them about the Sigil, and went looking for whoever took them.
notes_for_3d: Male owl-folk: owl face plate, beak and ear tufts, round spectacles, a long green robe with a feather capelet and flowing sleeves, scrolls on the belt, talons. Gnarled staff with hanging chimes.

name: Crusk Brineclaw
title: the Tidewarden
facial: custom:shell face plate with glowing teal eyes

outfit.head: custom:barnacled crab carapace hood with seaweed
acc: custom:great barnacled crab shell over the shoulders
custom:fishing net hanging from the belt

kit: custom:spiral nautilus shell shield with glowing pearls
silhouette: a wide hunched shell with two giant claws and a round spiral shield
signature: a nautilus shell shield whose pearls glow brighter with every blow it takes
pose: hunched behind the shell shield, claws raised
fx: a ring of spray and glowing pearls when he shields
story: Crusk has guarded the Saltreach breakwater since before the harbour had a name. He does not talk much. He does not need to: nothing has ever got past the shield.
notes_for_3d: Wide male with a crab head (shell face plate, glowing eyes), a big barnacled carapace over the back and head, giant claws on both forearms, a nautilus shell shield, net skirt and seaweed sash.

name: Hartwin Sunhorn
title: the Stag of Bellspire

outfit.head: custom:stag head with great golden antlers hung with little bells
acc: custom:white tabard with a golden sun

kit: custom:golden halo ring behind the antlers
custom:marble sun hammer with a glowing sun
silhouette: a tall stag knight in white and gold with a vast spread of antlers and a halo
signature: golden antlers hung with bells that toll a blessing over his allies
pose: hammer planted, head high, antler bells ringing
fx: the antler bells chime and a golden light pulses from the halo when he heals
story: The bells of Bellspire fell silent a century ago, but the white stag still walks the ruins, his antlers hung with the last of them. Where he goes, the bells ring again.
notes_for_3d: Tall male knight in white and gold plate with a stag head (muzzle, ears), great golden antlers hung with small bells, a halo ring behind them, a sun tabard, a long white cape. Marble hammer with a glowing sun.

name: Nyssa Duskwing
title: the Moth of Wraithmoor

hair.style: custom:short black hair under the hood

facial: custom:black cloth mask over the lower face and pale violet eyes

outfit.head: custom:grey hood with feathered moth antennae and a black cloth half mask over the lower face
acc: custom:large tattered grey moth wings with glowing violet eye spots

kit: custom:twin curved daggers with violet edges
silhouette: a slim hooded figure behind two huge tattered moth wings dotted with glowing eyes
signature: moth wings whose violet eye spots open and stare when she strikes from the dark
pose: low crouch, daggers reversed, wings half open
fx: violet smoke and drifting moth dust; the eye spots flare on a critical hit
story: The barrow-folk of Wraithmoor say the moths there carry the dreams of the dead. Nyssa was the one who learned to follow them, and now she carries their grudges too.
notes_for_3d: Slim female ranger in black leather and steel plates; a grey hood with feathered moth antennae and a lower-face mask; big tattered insect wings with glowing violet eye spots (the wing kit's moth type). Twin curved daggers with glowing edges.
